verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS with built-in AI features (AI Editor, Sprinto AI), so letting its AI connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Sprinto acting as an MCP client or letting users plug in MCP servers. Its integrations are fixed connectors (Jira, ClickUp) and inbound webhooks. The compliance-skills repo provides skills for external coding agents, not MCP-client support inside Sprinto.
